notes_long:
- Voice from call: 'we need predictable cost when we scale to 100s of customers'
- Workload: nightly batch runs (campaign generation), on-demand personalized snippets (per-user web requests). Typical job: 500-1,000 short variants per campaign; average prompt ~120 tokens; expected total tokens/day if scaled = 40M+ tokens.
- Targets: prefer sub-second median latency for interactive flows (<= 800ms ok), batching for nightly bulk runs to save cost. Interested in prefix/KV caching for templates and reuse across variations.
- Model preference: open/cheaper model variants ok if quality matches; fallback policy desired (low-cost variant -> higher-quality if flagged).
- Cost sensitivity: primary blocker. Asking for examples of batching configuration & cost math (tokens per item vs per-batch overhead).
- Security/compliance: SMB but EU customers require data residency; asked about regional endpoints and simple retention controls. SSO not required for now.
- POC asks: 1) sandbox token quota increase for 2 weeks, 2) sample batching + prefix cache config, 3) short writeup on expected cost per 1k generations using hosted_api.
- Next steps owner agreed to: provide tailored pricing spreadsheet, schedule 45min technical demo next week with SE, grant temporary token bump for POC.
- Internal notes: position as self-serve -> likely convert to paid hosted API; keep friction low, emphasize cost controls (caching, batch-run templates), surface traffic-based pricing bands.
